posts.zh:
DSH-Balance-display 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。侧边栏底部实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额徽章：数字滚轮动画、多币种支持、余额趋势图、按 Key 用量统计（含安装前历史回填），并支持 GitHub 版本自动检查。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-29c7adc1cc995feb9e3a.html
posts.en:
DSH-Balance-display is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Real-time DeepSeek account balance badge in the sidebar footer with odometer roll animation, multi-currency support, balance trend chart, per-key usage statistics with historical backfill, and GitHub version auto-check.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-29c7adc1cc995feb9e3a.html
